meta.title: Happy 1st Monthsary, My Love ❤️
meta.subtitle: One month down, forever to go.

hero.heading: Happy 1st Monthsary, My Love
hero.intro: This little website is my digital love letter for our first monthsary. Thank you for making ordinary days feel magical.

quotes: In your smile, I found my favorite home.
Every day with you feels like a gentle celebration.
You are my peace, my laughter, and my forever person.
Loving you is my easiest decision.
One month with you, and my heart already knows forever.

loveMeter.label: How full my heart is for you

surprise.title: A Little Surprise For You 💌
message: If I could relive one month forever, I'd choose this one with you every single time. I'm so grateful for you and for us, and I hope we keep growing and learning from each other, fighting fair and always finding our way back to each other. Thank you for always making me feel safe, seen, and loved. I promise to keep choosing you and making you feel special, every single day. Happy 1st monthsary, my love. I love you so much, and here's to many more memories to come!

loveLetter.title: My Letter To You
loveLetter.body: My love, in just one month, you became my safest home and my favorite adventure. Thank you for your patience, your laughter, your warmth, and the way you love me even on my quiet days. I promise to keep choosing you, understanding you, and celebrating you in all seasons of life. Happy 1st monthsary, my love. I love you endlessly.

timeline.title: The Beginning
timeline.description: The day our story officially started — my favorite plot twist.

timeline.title: Comfort Found
timeline.description: We talked for hours and it felt like home.

timeline.title: Sweet Little Habits
timeline.description: From good morning texts to good night calls, every little thing mattered.

timeline.title: Stronger Together
timeline.description: We learned how to listen, understand, and love deeper.

timeline.title: 1st Monthsary
timeline.description: Today we celebrate us — and all the moments still waiting for us.

reasons: Your smile can heal my hardest days.
You make me feel seen, heard, and valued.
You are both my peace and my excitement.
You love me in ways I once only prayed for.
You support my dreams like they are yours too.
You listen with your whole heart.
You make simple moments feel extraordinary.
You are my calm when life feels heavy.
You choose love every single day.
You make me laugh even when I try not to.
You make our relationship feel safe and beautiful.
You believe in me when I doubt myself.
You turn ordinary days into my favorite memories.
You are gentle with my heart and honest with your love.
You make me feel lucky, every single day.
You are my favorite hello and hardest goodbye.
You remind me that real love is peaceful.
You make forever sound exciting and warm.

memories.text: That moment we laughed so hard we forgot everything else.
Your sweet voice saying my name.
The calm I feel whenever you are with me.
The way you give your shoulders to lean on.
A little moment that felt like forever.
The day I realized I want more memories with you.
First Picnic Date with Bicol Express.
Teaching me how to ride a bike.
A first time memory I’ll keep in my heart forever.

celebration.title: Celebrate With Our Songs 🎶
celebration.description: Pick a song and let’s celebrate our 1st monthsary.

songs.name: You Make It Right
songs.poem: My love, when this song begins, my heart remembers how your love makes every broken piece in me feel whole again.

songs.name: Ikaw Lang Patutunguhan
songs.poem: Sa bawat tibok ng kantang ito, mahal ko, ikaw lang ang dulo ng lahat ng panalangin ko, ikaw lang ang patutunguhan ng puso ko.

songs.name: Be With You
songs.poem: If forever has a sound, it is this melody beside your name, my love, because all I want is to be with you in every season.

songs.name: Star Song
songs.poem: My dear love, even the stars seem quiet when you smile, because your light outshines the whole night sky in my world.

songs.name: I'd Rather Be With You
songs.poem: In a world of endless choices, my heart chooses only one truth again and again: I'd rather be with you.
